services.name: Student Matinee
services.desc: We are proud to offer a series of Student Matinees for our shows each season! Our Student Matinees are open to K-12 Students from all over Maryland. We offer a discounted $15/ticket price for attendees from private and independent schools that charge tuition. We also offer free tickets for attendees from all public schools in the state on a first come first serve basis and with priority given to Title 1 institutions. There will be two rounds of applications for this year’s Student Matinee performances, one each for the 2025 and 2026 portions of our season. The second round of applications is now live!
